events.description: 42. ORDER: It is hereby ORDERED that Defendants Brian Kemp and Brad Raffensperger' s Corrected Motion to Stay Discovery and All Pre Discovery Deadlines Pending Resolution of Motion to Dismiss 22 is GRANTED. It is further ORDERED that Plaintiffs Sarah E. Thompson and Edward T. Metz's Motion Requesting the Judge Recuse 25 is DENIED. Signed by Judge Mark H. Cohen on 1/2/2025.
